note: What a server sends to say what led to a death, so the client can lay it out.

fields.name: cause
fields.note: What sort of thing did it.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long the unit stays down, in seconds.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.note: How many entries follow. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: entries
fields.note: The entries themselves, one after another. Each opens with when it happened, how many times it did, what kind of thing it was, and what did it, and what follows that is settled by the kind. No capture has carried an entry, so the shapes past that opening are not recorded here.
